initial_prompt: Create a polished branding concept board for the open source project named exactly "mcp-unifi-rs". Use case: logo-brand exploration for a maintainer to choose a visual identity, not a product screenshot. Product: a Rust MCP server connecting AI clients to UniFi Network and Protect for inventory, troubleshooting, configuration reads and selected previewed network changes. It has no dashboard to mock up. Original independent project identity, not official Ubiquiti branding; no Ubiquiti U mark, no Rust gear, no shields, padlocks, robots, brains, holograms, generic circuit-board wallpaper, stock device photos, or invented marketing claims. Refined flat graphic design with ample whitespace and disciplined alignment. Landscape 1536x1024 concept sheet. Top small option title, dominant wide light-theme README header with mark + exact name "mcp-unifi-rs" and factual subtitle "MCP for UniFi Network & Protect". Below a wide dark-theme variant with exactly the same mark geometry. Bottom strip: two square avatar samples, a genuinely single-ink black mark, four color swatches, and four simple family icons for network, wireless, camera, and configuration. Keep all lettering large enough to read and minimal; no body paragraphs, fake code, hex labels or imaginary UI. Consistent mark across every placement, simple enough to later redraw as editable SVG. These are generated concept previews, not finished production assets. Exact board title: "01 / Warm connections". Palette warm ivory, charcoal ink, muted deep teal, small ochre accents. Approachable precise linework, softly rounded ends, restrained humanist sans typography. Main symbol is an original compact network junction: one central hollow circle joined by three short rounded branches to three terminal dots, arranged asymmetrically with balanced negative space and a strong silhouette. NO surrounding ring, NO enclosing terminal frame and NO letter U. Main symbol teal/ink with one tiny ochre endpoint. A quiet, sparse connection illustration of network and camera endpoints extends only at the far right of the header. This direction belongs beside warm, restrained technical projects while owning its network identity. Flat solid colors, absolutely no gradients or textures.
refinement_prompt: Edit this branding concept sheet. Preserve its original logo geometry, exact project name "mcp-unifi-rs", option title, typography, layout and illustrations. Correct the backgrounds and readability only. Replace ALL fog, dark blurry overlays, spotlights, gradients, mottling, shadows, texture and glowing areas with completely flat opaque solid backgrounds. Canvas background pure warm ivory. Top light-theme header background opaque near-white with dark readable text and a colored mark. Middle dark-theme header background opaque charcoal teal with pale readable text. Bottom strip background opaque warm ivory, all labels and icons dark ink with high contrast. All four palette swatches solid flat fills. Ensure option title is clearly readable dark ink on the ivory top area. Do not dim any part of the sheet. No transparent regions. Keep existing logo consistent. Remove every incidental slogan or extra phrase; in particular remove "SAME NETWORKS A BRIGHTER TOMORROW" if present. Preserve only option title, project name, factual subtitle "MCP for UniFi Network & Protect", and short bottom sample labels. Flat professional vector-like presentation. Do not introduce any new imagery or copy.
